morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 adanya；更底层词根为 ada。se- 中的 e 读 /ə/，与 ada 的首元音分属音节；ny 表示 /ɲ/。

word_family.gloss: 就现有的；有什么就用什么

senses.zh_definition: 就现有的条件或物品；有什么就用什么，不另作铺张准备。
senses.en_definition: Using whatever is available; with the resources at hand.
senses.nuances: 常用于招待客人时的谦辞，表示饭菜或安排朴素，并不一定表示实际匮乏或质量差。[DBP：seadanya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=seadanya)

collocations.zh: 以现有食材准备的简单饭菜
collocations.en: a simple meal made with what is available

senses.zh_definition: 依照原有或真实的状态；如其本来面貌，不要求改变或修饰。
senses.en_definition: As someone or something is, without alteration or embellishment.
senses.nuances: menerima seseorang seadanya 强调接纳对方本来的样子。语义核心是现有状态，不自动等于马虎、敷衍或无条件认可一切行为。[DBP：seadanya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=seadanya)

collocations.zh: 接纳一个人本来的样子
collocations.en: to accept someone as they are
to accept oneself as one is

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 资源说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan itu menggunakan peralatan seadanya untuk meneruskan kerja sementara menunggu bekalan baharu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该团队在等待新物资期间，利用现有设备继续工作。
dual_scenarios.en: The team continued working with the equipment available while awaiting new supplies.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 邀请朋友到家里吃饭
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Datanglah makan kat rumah, kita makan seadanya je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Datanglah makan di rumah; kita makan seadanya sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 来家里吃饭吧，我们就随便吃点现成的。
dual_scenarios.en: Come over for a meal. We'll just have whatever's available.

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友兼主人)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau kau nak datang malam ni, boleh je. Kita makan seadanya, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Jika kamu hendak datang malam ini, boleh sahaja. Kita makan seadanya, ya.
messages.zh: 你今晚想来的话就来吧。我们就吃点家里有的，好吗。
messages.en: You're welcome to come over tonight. We'll just have whatever's in the kitchen, okay?

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友兼客人)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh! Tak payah susah-susah, aku nak jumpa kau je.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh! Tidak perlu bersusah payah; saya hanya hendak berjumpa dengan kamu.
messages.zh: 好啊！不用特意忙活，我就是想见见你。
messages.en: Sounds good! Don't go to any trouble. I just want to see you.

etymology.historical_story: Seadanya is built from the Malay base ada, meaning to exist or be available, rather than borrowed as a complete foreign word. Its meanings connect available resources with an existing personal condition. At a meal, it can modestly describe what the host has prepared; in a relationship, it expresses accepting someone as they are.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ada＝有：seadanya 就是“有什么就用什么；原来怎样就怎样”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 主人说 makan seadanya 常是谦逊待客，客人可回应 Terima kasih 或 Tak perlu bersusah payah，表达感谢并让主人放松。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用来描述自己的招待通常自然；主动评价别人准备的饭菜只是 seadanya，可能显得嫌弃。谈接纳他人时适合表达尊重与理解。
